observations.finding: Each data column toggles ascending/descending. Use raw typed values, stable ties and nulls last. Keep the sort after refresh.
Sort the complete query before pagination. Keep groups and totals fixed. Action columns declare no comparator. Photo columns use capture time.
Open the shared lightbox on click or Enter. Escape closes. Trap focus and restore the opener. Arrow keys and buttons page.
Page across cursors without duplicate photos. Keep selection by id. Show index or unknown total, caption, load failure and retry. Revoke blob URLs.
Use the camera SVG/path and button tokens. Give a name. Disable duplicate capture. No emoji-only control.
Map source states to taken, queued, processing, processed, failed. Keep failed separate from pending. Show unknown totals as unknown.
Show queued, sent, acknowledged, failed or expired. Mark success only after acknowledgement. Reconcile retries by operation id.
Render loading, empty, ready, stale, offline, paused, denied and error when applicable. Retry preserves inputs and prior data.
Use shared tokens, type scale, spacing, focus ring and disabled style. Icons keep accessible names. Test light and dark themes.
Use only text needed for operation or structure. No repeated helper prose. Preserve names for assistive tools.
Complete each action by keyboard and screen reader. Use semantic roles, labels, focus order, aria-sort and live status. No color-only state.
Meet WCAG 2.2 AA contrast as the test target. Use 44 CSS px web and 48 dp native targets. Respect reduced motion and text scaling.
At 320, 768 and 1280 CSS px and 200% text, keep actions reachable. Only the table region can scroll horizontally. Preserve focus and draft on redraw.
Use declared typed tables and photo refs. Follow every data cursor. Export includes all accessible rows and source-photo links. Stateless applets need no table.
Use expected revision, stable ids and idempotency keys. Reject stale writes. Use undo or explicit confirmation for destructive actions. Never run an automatic account reset.
Preserve per-owner and per-instance grants. Keep secrets write-only. Redact logs. Test revoke, deletion, retention and cross-owner denial.
Expose authenticated reads and applicable create/update/clear/delete/rotate operations. Share UI validation. Publish discovery and HTTP/MCP contracts.
Discover actual capability, permission and readiness. Keep OS and owner consent. Never add a grant, paid call or upload during inspection.
Read development snapshot. Preserve baseline, settings, stable ids, intentional removals and journal. Use three-way merge. Block conflicts before activation.
Negotiate catalog and component versions. Reject unsupported changes before mutation. Keep the working revision. Respect paused and detached copies.
Dry-run migration on a copy. Test interrupted apply and recovery. Keep records and photos. Do not promise rollback until restore tests pass.
Bound fetches, image decode, retries and polling. Abort on instance switch. Ignore stale replies. Test large data and slow networks.
Record catalog review: added, changed or no-new-practice with reason. Name affected rule ids and changed surfaces. No empty attestation.
Derive applicability from package and code. Emit pass, fail, exception, not-applicable, unverified or legacy-debt. Bind evidence to artifact and runtime hashes.
